name: @terra-symposium/standards-error-boundaries
description: Framework-neutral React error boundaries for Terra Symposium applications

scripts.build: tsc -p config/tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/components && cp src/components/AstroErrorBoundary.astro dist/components/AstroErrorBoundary.astro
scripts.test: npm run build && mkdir -p tests/results && node --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=tests/results/junit.xml tests/*.test.mjs
